parts.text: Which explanation matches the chapter idea?

options.text: Earth supports life because linked conditions near its surface—such as air, water, soil, food, and shelter—work together.
Earth supports life only because it has water; no other conditions matter.
Earth supports life only because it is the largest rocky planet.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Hitesh compares two explanations for why Earth can support life while a bare rocky body with no linked surface conditions cannot.

part_answers.answer: Life needs several linked conditions together, not one feature alone.

teacher.key_rationale: Earth's ability to support life comes from linked surface conditions working together, not from one feature such as water or size alone.
